## ⛔ STOP — do not file this as a public issue

Real customer data leaks in published templates are by definition something we don't want public. Use GitHub's **private security advisory** flow instead:

👉 https://github.com/3awny/qship/security/advisories/new

Or email ahmedawny.one@gmail.com directly with subject `[qship leak]`.

A public issue with the leaked content reproduces the leak. Don't.

If you're sure this is a non-sensitive bug and you want a public issue, switch to the "Bug report" template instead.
